title: Carriage by Air Act 17 of 1946
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Carriage by Air Act 17 of 1946'. Commencement: 22 March 1955. Amended by Carriage by Air Amendment Act 15 of 2006. There is no repeal tag.
notes: Gives effect to the Warsaw/Montreal regime on carrier liability for passenger injury, delay and baggage, and extends it to domestic carriage. South Africa has no EU261-style statutory compensation for delay or denied boarding.
